verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents a REST API that can create workflows, manage event sources and handle subscriptions [pipedream-docs-6]. It also offers a CLI for deploying and live-developing sources and streaming events [pipedream-docs-7, pipedream-docs-8, pipedream-docs-9], plus Connect SDKs and REST APIs for auth, usage and proxying [pipedream-docs-17, pipedream-docs-19, pipedream-docs-39]. Nothing in the evidence claims full UI parity, and some features are described only as UI actions, such as clicking Send Test Event and debugging errors with AI [pipedream-docs-13, pipedream-docs-16]. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage for workflow editing, testing, error handling and debugging, and independent or hands-on confirmation of API completeness.
